## A. Document-level

- **doc_date = NOT STATED for every document.** No DCP PDF prints an issue date, only a document code (e.g. 08-0176-QA-A-2026). The footnote “Source: <product> TDS, <doc code>, <date>” will therefore read `NOT STATED` for the date. (PDF metadata creation dates exist but are not document dates and are not used.)
- Document codes of the Qatar set mostly lack the “QA” region token (e.g. 08-0199-A-2026), while the Lebanon/Jordan/other sites host other revisions of the same product. I used the Qatar set as baseline — ASSUMED. Other regional versions were NOT compared.

## C. Decisions needed

1. Include or drop PU-P100, PU-H50, PU-C100 and every table-2 product (scope sheet).
2. DonProof L / R are sheets, Setseal 300C / R are not joint sealants, Strongcoat HB is a floor coating — confirm drop/keep (scope sheet §5).
3. Zone E has no TDS support in the listed products — approve waterstop/hydrophilic products or leave E out.
4. Missing documents: DonProof Primer PU, Primer EP, Repcoat FF Plus, “aliphatic PU topcoats” (which product?), Repcoat P Ultra (named by the PU-H50 method statement).
5. Brief §3.4 says show coverage as m²/kg or m²/ltr, but §3.3 says never convert. TDS print kg/m² (spray), litre/m² (acrylics). I store and will show them **as printed**. ASSUMED until you rule.
6. Swimming pools / aquariums → zone D mapping (marked ASSUMED).
7. PRIMER_NAMING stays “legacy” (default) — nothing built yet depends on it.
8. Products whose TDS also list car-park decks (PU-P150, PU-P100, PU-H50, PU-C100 “parking”, FB “underground car parks”, EPW): the car-park use will not be shown; other uses will. Confirm.
9. HS shelf life: TDS is silent (the 5-year figure in my first read belongs to DonProof R — the build check caught that).

## D. Data-quality notes (checked, not blocking)

- DonProof L and R list tensile/elongation per grade; stored as printed strings with grade in the value. A chart will need a per-grade selection rule.
- DonProof L / R “service_temp” entries are *foldability at low temperature*, not service ranges — do not use as such.
- Older PDFs (Setseal 300C, Repcoat S/PU1) lose the “ti/fi” ligatures in text extraction; checked values are numeric so verification is unaffected.
- The page check confirms the printed text is on the cited page; it cannot prove the number is attached to the right label — values were read by me and should be spot-checked by DCP R&D.
